finding.wifi-channel.clear.other: %1 other networks share this Wi-Fi channel.

finding.dns.plaintext-measured: This computer sends its DNS lookups unencrypted.

action.ssh-off: Turn off SSH access on the router unless you use it yourself.
action.telnet-off: Turn off Telnet on the router; it sends passwords unencrypted.
action.https-only: Use HTTPS-only for the router admin page if the router offers it.
action.use-https: Open the router admin page with https:// instead of http://.
action.tr069-off: Turn off TR-069 remote management if your provider does not need it.
action.upnp-review: Review the UPnP port mappings in the router and turn UPnP off if nothing needs it.
action.upnp-off: Turn UPnP off in the router if no game console or app needs it.
action.upnp-other: Find out which device on the network answers UPnP searches.
action.wifi-wpa: Switch the Wi-Fi to WPA2-AES or WPA3 in the router.
action.wifi-check: Check in the router that Wi-Fi security is WPA2-AES or WPA3.
action.wps-off: Turn off WPS in the router; switch it on only while you add a device.
action.wifi-channel: Move the Wi-Fi to a less crowded channel, or set the channel to automatic.
action.dns-computer: Click the network icon in the bar and set DNS to Cloudflare or Google.
action.dns-router: Turn on DNS over TLS or DNS over HTTPS in the router or on your devices.
action.dns-check: Check your DNS settings; this computer's resolver could not be read.
button.askTip: Opens your Omarchy default agent on this report

watch.label: Alert me when something changes

watch.detail.one: Rescans this network about every minute and notifies you.
watch.detail.other: Rescans this network about every %1 minutes and notifies you.

info.intro: A finding is a router setting worth changing. It does not mean anyone has got in.
info.yellow.note: Safe to use. A few settings could be tighter.
info.orange.note: Fix the listed items when you can.
info.caps: One serious finding always shows red; one moderate finding, orange at best. Under 60% evidence never shows green.
info.reachable: "Reachable" means from this computer at home, not from the internet.
info.unknown: "Unknown" means not measured. It lowers the evidence figure, not the score.
cap.high: At risk because of a serious finding, whatever the number says.
cap.medium: Needs attention because of a moderate finding, whatever the number says.
cap.coverage: Not rated Good because under 60% of the checks could be measured.
